title: 1894 pen-drawing rules as an SVG preflight contract
purpose: Maps four mechanism-level rules from art_01M6Q6XXX3DEFQ6QST964PTW6M r1 (scale ratio, colour-channel separation, stroke openness, layer hygiene) onto a modern SVG print pipeline as explicit, checkable interfaces. All SVG connections are curator inference, labelled as such. Not executed.
attribution: Source: art_01M6Q6XXX3DEFQ6QST964PTW6M revision 1 — documented summary of Harper, A Practical Hand-book of Drawing for Modern Methods of Reproduction (1894), eBook 60972, lines 1757–1812, Gutenberg plain-text file. No copyright or public-domain determination is made.
All SVG mappings and rule thresholds are curator inference; the handbook covers no digital practice.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
